upsert_chat_message: upsert a chat message into the database with role, content, model_id, and usage data
get_messages_by_chat_id: get all messages for a specific chat ordered by creation time ascending
get_token_usage_by_model: get aggregated token usage statistics grouped by model with optional date range and group filters
get_daily_message_counts_by_model: get daily message counts grouped by model and date with missing days filled in
delete_messages_by_chat_id: delete all messages associated with a specific chat_id from the database
